description: This is a PHP acceptance test class for the Documents module in SuiteCRM. It uses Faker for data generation and includes a test scenario for viewing the Documents module as an administrator.

classes.name: DocumentsCest
classes.description: Acceptance test class for the Documents module, containing setup and a test scenario for viewing the module.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Initial setup method that initializes Faker data generator and seeds it for consistency across tests.

methods.name: testScenarioViewDocumentsModule
methods.description: Test scenario for verifying that an administrator can view the Documents module list page and its title.
